result.summary: The food delivery home screen is largely well-composed. One clear defect was found: a spelling error in the search field placeholder. No layout, alignment, or rendering issues were observed beyond the excluded carousel/viewport clipping.

issues.description: Search bar placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
